awarding_entity: REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL)
nature_of_order: Development, financing, design, engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of transmission assets
significant_terms: Selection of Dilip Buildcon Limited as Successful Bidder to acquire 100% equity of the Project SPV and act as Transmission Service Provider (TSP) for development, ownership, operation, and maintenance of the Intra-State Transmission System on Build, Own, Operate and Transfer (BOOT) basis under Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) route and Transmission Service Agreement (TSA)
execution_period_raw: Construction and commissioning to be completed within 24 months from the Effective Date, as per RFP
consideration_raw: Awarded Project to be implemented under Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) model. | EPC for DBL (excluding GST): INR 1265 crore (excluding GST)
labeller_notes: Declared L-1 / successful bidder for 400 kV GIS Solapur/Paranda Switching Station (Dist. Dharashiv), Maharashtra. RECPDCL acts as Bid Process Coordinator on behalf of Maharashtra State Transmission Utility. 'Broad consideration' row gives no figure; value_inr taken from the separate 'EPC for DBL (excluding GST)' row. Operation period is 35 years from COD after the 24-month construction period.
